editorial.blurb: A charming neighborhood café where excellent coffee, fresh sandwiches, and rotating local art create a welcoming spot to linger.
editorial.insiderTip: Order in a mug if you want one—the baristas are reliably attentive—and grab a seat on the pleasant patio to enjoy your drink while taking in the gallery walls.

topDishes.note: A local favorite that keeps regulars coming back
